ingredients.name: white wine, chicken broth, or alcohol-free white wine

steps.instruction: Place 1 1/2 cups of chopped onion and 3 pounds of chicken parts in a slow cooker.
steps.spoken: Place 1 and a half cups of chopped onion and 3 pounds of chicken parts, with the skin removed, in a 3 and a half quart slow cooker.

steps.instruction: In a bowl, add 1 can of tomatoes with juice and 1 can of tomato paste.
Add 1 can of drained mushroom pieces, 1 bay leaf and 1 teaspoon of salt.
Add 1/4 teaspoon of pepper and 1/4 teaspoon of garlic powder.
Add 1 teaspoon of dried oregano and 1/2 teaspoon of dried basil.
Add 1/4 cup of white wine, 1/2 teaspoon of gravy browner and 1 teaspoon of sugar.
steps.spoken: Add 1/4 cup of white wine, chicken broth, or alcohol-free white wine, then 1/2 teaspoon of liquid gravy browner and 1 teaspoon of sugar.

steps.instruction: Stir everything in the bowl together.
Pour the mixture over the chicken so the chicken is covered.

steps.spoken: Cook on low for 6 to 8 hours, or on high for three to four hours.
